title: Camera firmware versions MV 5.0 changelog

announcements.post_subject: A new beta camera firmware is now available on Tue, 01 Nov 2022

Note: Upgrading to this firmware does NOT allow for the ability to downgrade to MV 4.X branch
Smart Codec support is enabled in this firmware branch (MV12/MV32/MV22(x)/MV72(x)/MV63(x)/MV93(x))
Bug fixes: Resolve an issue where live video streaming can become intermittent due to a software fault
General: Improved connectivity performance for MT sensors
Improved accuracy and performance of vehicle and person detection
Improved performance of motion recap image generation

html:
Camera firmware versions MV 5.0 changelog

Note

  • Upgrading to this firmware does NOT allow for the ability to downgrade to MV 4.X branch
  • Smart Codec support is enabled in this firmware branch (MV12/MV32/MV22(x)/MV72(x)/MV63(x)/MV93(x))

New

  • Initial firmware support for MV63/MV63X/MV93/MV93X

Bug fixes

  • Resolve an issue where live video streaming can become intermittent due to a software fault

General

  • Improved connectivity performance for MT sensors
  • Improved accuracy and performance of vehicle and person detection
  • Improved performance of MV Sense
  • Improved performance of motion recap image generation
  • General stability and performance improvements
